about: Review checklist for reconstructed DISPLAY geometry (CLAUDE.md: reconstructed display geometry). Script-checked items are updated by tools/airport_map/*; sign-off is Franco's only. Predictions, routing or position inference on this airport stay OFF until every item passes AND it is signed off, and even then they are a separate change.

items.check: Reconstruction (original FAA styling) rendered at the same scale as the FAA PDF: FAA ink covered and extra ink, 1 px tolerance at 300 dpi.
items.thresholds_note: same for every airport (fixed before the first KLGA measurement)

items.check: Every NASR runway end within 30 m of the diagram-derived end (display sign-off threshold, Franco D3). Predictions will need a stricter threshold (~10 m), to be set later.

result.graticule: decoded from outlines; this NASR runway-end check is its required independent verification (Franco, Oct 9)

items.check: Runway count and end identifiers match NASR and the diagram labels exactly.

result.note: NASR also lists helipad H1; the diagram labels it H1 (checked separately as a held-out point)

items.check: Every diagram taxiway label is matched to an OSM ref, or listed and explained.
items.note: Letter-named taxiways: every difference decided by Franco's rules R1-R7 (Oct 9; docs/TAXIWAY_NAMES_REVIEW.md). No numbered gate lead-ins on this chart. Nothing auto-resolved.

items.check: Hot-spot label callouts match the hot-spot outlines on the diagram (not_applicable if the chart has none).
Each ILS HOLD annotation has its dashed hold line found (not_applicable if the chart has none; FAA APDs do not draw every hold position).
No unclassified objects, or each listed one reviewed.
Today is inside the diagram's effective window, FAA's d-TPP metafile lists the same APD, and the served PDF has the same sha256.
Each LAHSO callout has its dashed hold-short marker across a runway (n labels / n markers; not_applicable if the chart has none). Display only.

geometry_of_record.decision: Chart-derived (reconstructed) geometry is for DISPLAY only. Any future prediction logic must use NASR runway-end coordinates (and the reviewed OSM network) as the geometry of record, never chart-traced positions. Predictions stay OFF until this checklist passes and Franco signs off, and are then a separate change.
geometry_of_record.scope_note: Decided for KLGA on 2026-10-08; applied to every airport by the checklist template (tools/airport_map/checklist.py).
